notes.title: WESTERN CITY DLC IS RELEASED
notes.content:
ALL HIT ALL HER: WESTERN CITY
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40444846/df573c9becc475de60284c5580736ba28e3c0439.png
Western City Dlc is released.
With this new dlc you will defend your city against the bandits invading your city in the wild west lands.
Added with the new dlc:
[olist]
[1] New Level Maps
[2] New Weapons
[3] New Enemys
[4] New Atmosphere
[/olist]
